dina_sales: Heads-up — Acme POC requested our incident response / breach notification timeline and a sample notice. They also want the difference between hosted vs VPC notification obligations. Need something I can send by EOD.

ashley_security: Short answer: we provide an initial notification for confirmed incidents (typical customer-facing language: 'initial notification within 72 hours of confirmation') and follow-ups as we learn more. For hosted customers we own the notification process; for VPC/on-prem we support the customer (we provide facts and forensic artifacts) but they usually send external notices. I’ll paste a tiny template below.

ashley_security: ```Subject: Initial Incident Notification — [Customer]

What happened: brief summary of what was discovered and impacted services.
Scope: what data types/systems are involved (customer IDs, S3 buckets, etc.) — we only include confirmed scope.
What we know: timeline of detection, containment steps taken, current status.
Mitigation: immediate remediation actions and recommended customer actions.
Next steps: scheduled follow-ups, point of contact (ir@redwood.com), and expected ETA for root cause.
```

matt_legal: Quick legal clarifications: 1) "72 hours" is from confirmed compromise/discovery of a breach not from initial alert if still under investigation; 2) include standard language about no admission of liability and that notifications are factual; 3) route copies to legal@redwood.com and security@redwood.com so we can preserve privilege where appropriate.

jordan_ps: Buyer also asked whether we map this to SIG/CAIQ. Can we point them to our SIG answers that specifically call out IR controls (IR-1..IR-8)? They want to show their risk team.

ashley_security: Yes — we maintain a SIG/CAIQ mapping PDF. Internal link: https://redwood-internal.s3/ir/sigs/ir-mapping.pdf (can give external share on request). We document tabletop cadence (annual + after major infra changes) and retention of IR artifacts for 1 year.

ashley_security: For the POC: recommend offering a 6-month tabletop and a turn-key runbook review as an add-on. That usually satisfies risk teams during evaluation.

ashley_security: Quick escalation matrix snippet you can drop in the SOW:
- Primary IR contact: security@redwood.com (monitored 24/7)
- Legal escalation: legal@redwood.com (business hours)
- Dedicated account lead (if on Dedicated/Private): <AM name/email>
- For VPC customers: we coordinate evidence delivery to their SOC/forensics team.

matt_legal: Pricing note: IR retainer / tabletop facilitation is a professional services line item, typically billed annually. It is separate from Dedicated capacity fees. I can provide a range (e.g., $10–30k/year depending on scope) if you want a ballpark for negotiation.

dina_sales: Great — can you give me a 3–4 bullet summary I can paste to the buyer (non-legal)? Also confirm we can provide the SIG extract for IR controls.

ashley_security: Pasteable bullets: 
- Initial customer-facing notification: initial factual notice within 72 hours of confirmed compromise, with follow-ups as we learn more.
- Hosted vs VPC: Hosted — Redwood issues notifications per contract; VPC/on-prem — customer controls external notice, Redwood provides evidence and assistance.
- SIG/CAIQ: We can provide a SIG extract showing IR control mappings and our tabletop cadence.
- Optional add-on: IR retainer and tabletop facilitation available as a paid service.

ashley_security: (Escalation contact quick list) security@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com, and your account lead. :thumbsup:

ir_bot: Incident template created: inc-2026-0942 — internal reference only.

dina_sales: Thanks team — sending this to the buyer now. If they ask for the SIG PDF externally I’ll loop legal to handle the NDA. :rocket:
